system.notes:
Hunchbacked, sorcerous giant spider with an exposed, goopy brain inset in the head. Can shapeshift. Often hides amongst mortal society, collecting magic.

AC 12, HP 9, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + poison) or 1 spell +2, MV near (climb), S +0, D +1, C +0, I +2, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2

Charm Person (INT Spell). DC 11. LV 2 or less, friendship for 1d8 days.

Detect Magic (INT Spell). Self. DC 11. Detect magic within near.

Jaunt (INT Spell). Self. DC 12. Teleport within near.

Poison. CON 12+ or paralyzed 1d4 hours.

Shapeshift. In place of attacks, transform into a humanoid or return to their original form. They can only shapeshift into one humanoid form.
